prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the sandstone canyon floor in front of the rose-red Treasury at Petra, a smooth sandy path and standard-height rock-cut doorways, empty of tourists, warmly lit by the low golden sun, long soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in warm golden-hour sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Jamaican person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a striking young male model face with sharp straight brows, a strong chin and a visible Adam's apple, a very faint trace of stubble, bold emerald-green eyeliner with a sheer burgundy-stained lip, smooth deep caramel-brown skin, a calm easy look, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large silver hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a copper cube-shaped block, a gold round bell, a silver small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked gold bracelets. Extra long nails in matching polished labradorite.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous but athletic woman, far beyond any real person; a flat, firmly defined stomach with faint abdominal muscle lines, a very narrow waist, strong rounded shoulders and toned arms, powerful toned thighs and a high firm rounded rear, yet a colossal full bust and wide round hips that keep the dramatic hourglass shape; hard fit muscle under glowing skin, not bulky, not thin, not boyish; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: full body polished labradorite fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING dark grey labradorite surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID electric blue and gold flashes shimmering through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her face and ears are real living skin, and her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved labradorite.

LEFT Cracks: the labradorite body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her belly, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her right shoulder and one at her right hip, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw grey stone with a rough chalky surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the labradorite is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
LEFT Pose: turned away from the camera, looking back over her shoulder, one hand brushing her hip, the other hanging down.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme pointed platform stiletto pumps in black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved labradorite right down to the shoes.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Korean man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, luminous porcelain skin, a gentle soft smile, deep dark brown hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large silver hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a silver small flared temple bell, a lead square-sided cowbell, a bronze teardrop-shaped sinker, a tin hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten rose-gold necklaces. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily tall and large man, far beyond any real person, with a men's physique build. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a minimal mirror-polished metallic black leather micro brief of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering him, paired with a mirror-polished metallic black leather chest harness of thin crossing straps with mirror-polished metallic silver ring hardware, his chest and stomach otherwise fully visible.
RIGHT Pose: both hands sweeping his hair back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme black platform stiletto heels, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the warm low sun in glowing glints, the golden light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
